options.description:
Calling all AI Builders to San Francisco.
Let's come together.
Show strength in numbers.

6pm to 9pm. Meetup. Community demos. Light bites and drinks.
9pm to midnight. Dance party! DJs!
Open source and open models give us the freedom to build, share, and control our tech. Let’s bring together the community making that future possible.
